reading.body:
Google operates a data center facility in northwest Omaha, Douglas County, as part of a multi-county Nebraska presence that also includes a Sarpy County campus reported at approximately $600 million. Google does not publish power capacity, square footage, or specific specifications for individual buildings, so the scale of this Douglas County site cannot be determined from company disclosure. The facility was announced in 2022 as part of a broader Nebraska growth plan.

This campus is one of 21 mapped data center facilities in Nebraska, but no operators in the state publish individual facility power figures, making any ranking by scale impossible. The Sarpy County corridor hosts multiple operators including Yahoo and Travelers alongside Google, suggesting regional infrastructure density that may support large-scale compute deployment.

Without published specifications, the importance of this site to AI scaling cannot be assessed from available data. The campus exists and is verified, but its power draw, rack count, and actual role in grid and compute constraints remain undisclosed.
